title: v3 invoke request (explicit payload transport)
description: Request body a host sends to a plugin action under contract_version 3. Compared with v2 the only structural change is that the exported tree is no longer a top-level `tree` property: it moves behind a `payload` descriptor that states how it is transported (inline or pull) together with its media type, byte length and SHA-256. Everything else - invocation identity, scope-minimized user, project, source, options, and the callback destination components - is carried unchanged, so a plugin that already implements v2 adds payload handling rather than a second protocol. v3 is negotiated, never assumed: a host may only send it when the plugin lists 3 in supported_contract_versions, and pull mode additionally requires capabilities.payload_pull. A plugin that supports neither continues to receive v1/v2 and is told plainly when its input is too large, instead of silently receiving a shape it cannot parse.

contract_version.description: Fixed to 3 for the explicit-payload-transport contract.

options.description: Per-invocation options collected by the host's confirmation UI, shaped by the action's manifest options_schema. Options travel on the request body in every payload mode - they are small, they are part of what the user confirmed, and they are covered by the request signature - so they are never moved behind the payload descriptor.
